_comment: Connector-trigger --detail payload for a UiPath Flow Outlook trigger.
This file captures the configuration you would pass to:
uip maestro flow node configure <PROJECT>.flow <triggerId> --detail '<contents>' --output json
(resolved from: uip maestro flow registry search 'outlook email received' --output json)
How each placeholder is resolved in a live environment:
CONNECTION_ID  : uip is connections list 'microsoft-office-365-emails' --all-folders --output json
→ pick the enabled connection (prefer IsDefault:Yes); capture its Id
or read from CLI login context: uip orchestrator folders list --output json
EVENT_MODE     : from 'uip maestro flow registry get <trigger-node-type> --connection-id <id>'
parentFolderId : uip is resources run list 'microsoft-office-365-emails' 'MailFolder'
